message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Update vuln-list-debian repo
on:
  schedule:
  - cron: "0 */6 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update:
    name: Update vuln-list-debian
    runs-on: ubuntu-2404-2core
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      VULN_LIST_DIR: "vuln-list-debian"
    steps:
    - name: Check out code
      uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8 # v5.0.0
      with:
        persist-credentials: false

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@4dc6199c7b1a012772edbd06daecab0f50c9053c # v6.1.0
      with:
        go-version-file: go.mod

    - name: Cache Go modules
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/go/pkg/mod
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

    - name: Check out vuln-list-debian repo
      uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8 # v5.0.0
      with:
        repository: ${{ github.repository_owner }}/${{ env.VULN_LIST_DIR }}
        path: ${{ env.VULN_LIST_DIR }}
        persist-credentials: false # update-source action mints a fresh token per push

    - name: Setup github user email and name
      run: |
        git config --global user.email "action@github.com"
        git config --global user.name "GitHub Action"

    - name: Compile vuln-list-update
      run: go build -o vuln-list-update .

    - if: always()
      name: Debian Security Bug Tracker
      uses: ./.github/actions/update-source
      with:
        target: debian
        client-id: ${{ secrets.SA_GH_VULN_LIST_UPDATE_GH_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
        private-key: ${{ secrets.SA_GH_VULN_LIST_UPDATE_GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
        repository: ${{ env.VULN_LIST_DIR }}
        commit-message: "Debian Security Bug Tracker"

    - name: Slack Notification
      uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@45a88b9581bfab2566dc881e2cd66d334e621e2c # v3.0.3
      if: failure()
      with:
        webhook: ${{ secrets.TRIVY_SLACK_WEBHOOK }}
        webhook-type: incoming-webhook
        payload: |
          text: ":x: *${{ github.workflow }}* workflow failed — <${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}|view run>"",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a Go project (go.mod/go.sum present) that runs on a fixed schedule every 6 hours and fetches Go module dependencies on every run via `go build`. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (dependency_cache) is applicable: repeated dependency fetching is measurable from the scheduled run history, and cache inputs include the lockfile (go.sum) plus runner environment. Adding an `actions/cache@v4` step for `~/go/pkg/mod`, keyed on `runner.os` and `hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum')`, placed after `setup-go` and before the build, reuses downloaded modules across runs without changing any build, test, or notification behavior. The experiment example for this pattern reported 6.06% elapsed savings with identical success counts, and the literature pattern reports modest aggregate VM-time reduction. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or privileged actions are added, no new network access is introduced, and all existing steps and required checks are preserved.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
